verdict.rationale: Channel3's own API is proprietary. However, it exposes its catalog through open protocols that independent parties implement. Its MCP server connects to third-party clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode), it accepts any UCP-capable agent, and it takes payment via MPP. That makes it a participant in open ecosystems rather than a purely private integration. missing for 10: evidence that independent parties implement Channel3's own platform or protocol, documentation of the open protocols' governance or other implementers beyond client compatibility claims, independent corroboration of the UCP and MPP integrations.
